about:
Marcole Enterprises operates from Manchester, Tennessee. The company's founding year is not explicitly stated, though it references over 40 years of experience. Ownership structure and founders are not disclosed in the available information.

The company manufactures custom wire harnesses, cable assemblies, power cords, electro-mechanical assemblies, and control boxes. Production uses state-of-the-art automated equipment at its Manchester facility. The firm works from customer prints through full production runs, though specific facility size, headcount, and annual volumes are not published.

Marcole serves original equipment manufacturers across sectors that require engineered interconnect solutions. The company states its products support "some of the most recognized companies in the world," but does not name specific industries or customers in the provided materials.

The company emphasizes a culture of continuous improvement and a comprehensive quality process under ISO 9001:2015, UL, and CSA certifications. It positions on-time delivery and quality assurance as core commitments to keep customer production lines running.
